page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number 236 at top left. Main text in one block of justified lines. Marginal notes in the left margin (Plutarch, Nicia; Thucyd. 1.6; Diodor. 1.1) and in the left margin near the SPARTANORUM heading (Thucyd. 1.4). Right margin is largely cropped and shows only fragments of text.

main_text.l: In SICILIA duo a Selinuntiis & Segestanis
definitis bella gesta sunt. Primum auxilio Athenien-
ium fubnixi, initium duce Nicia & Lama-
ch̄o felix, exitus adeo triftis, ut Siculi Dux interfectus
Syracusis, et Hermocrate in exilium pofti miflo, chalceum sanxerunt

l.i: nenses ab Aegeftanis acciti, cum per legatos rem
suam quaerere, a Syracufanis obtinere potuerunt, pro Himilcone Han-
in mari victoria, occupavere. Interim Hermo-
crates exulis, Syraculos ab amicis receptus, et Iatta
didit, qui Agrigentinos & Gelanos a Carthagi-

main_text.l: res gestae hic commixtae in ofto prima
anno verfantur. Hoc Athenienses, rursus a Mi-
per Brasidam occupata, Athenienses ad sanctum
inducias peterent, ad gerere. Nono itaque urbem in
Thracia faciliunt, fed cum Scionaei & Mindi ad Lycaonem
fidem deditum erant. Athenienses inducias rupti sunt
sunt. Brasida vero & Clearcho ad Amphipolin.

page.notes: Marginal text at the right edge and parts of the left-margin notes are cropped or very faint; several words in the body are unclear and are transcribed as best possible.
